items.title: Amazon earnings: AWS's growth rate 'no doubt' justifies the big AI spending
items.summary: Amazon (AMZN) reported second quarter earnings results that beat Wall Street's expectations. CFRA Research senior vice president of equity research, Arun Sundaram, chats with Yahoo Finance about his expectations for AWS.

items.title: Amazon Q2 earnings results beat Wall Street's estimates, as AWS continues to boom
items.summary: Amazon (AMZN) reported second quarter results on Thursday after the closing bell, with revenue coming in at $200.60 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $197.01 billion). Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré takes a closer look at the breaking numbers.
